_doc: Strategic-sites reference layer (RAW). Researched coordinates + metadata; positions are approximate site centroids, good to ~1km — fine for map markers, NOT survey-grade. Each entry lists why it matters to a tradable exposure. Source: public maps/filings knowledge, cross-checked against operator public materials. Served via /api/data/sites.

sites.name: Cushing Oil Hub (WTI delivery point)
sites.relevance: WTI futures physical delivery point; ~10% of US crude storage. Tank-shadow fill estimates here are the Sentinel-2 SIGNAL candidate (vs EIA weekly ground truth). Exposure: USO, XLE, CL futures.
sites.note: Hub centroid; individual terminals ring the town.

sites.name: Enbridge Cushing Terminal
sites.relevance: Largest single Cushing operator (~20M bbl shell capacity).

sites.name: Steel Dynamics — Butler Flat Roll
sites.relevance: STLD's original flat-roll mill. Yard inventory change detection is a future SIGNAL candidate (capacity-constrained mid-cap angle).

sites.name: Steel Dynamics — Sinton Flat Roll
sites.relevance: Newest EAF flat-roll mill (2022 ramp); its utilization is a live earnings variable.

sites.name: Steel Dynamics — Structural & Rail
sites.relevance: Structural steel + rail; nonresidential construction proxy.

sites.name: Port of Los Angeles
sites.relevance: #1 US container port. Ship-queue counts (AIS) here were the classic 2021 supply-chain signal. Exposure: retail (XRT), logistics (IYT).

sites.name: Port of Long Beach
sites.relevance: #2 US container port; shares San Pedro Bay anchorage with POLA.
